# Rare Clothes Blueprints - Random Encounters

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_61_nukaknights-post-seltene-klamotten-random-encounter.jpg)

![Magga](/public/avatar_Magga_04C0D4FC-E28D-40E4-B92A-125A6A726E0F.png) 

#### In this post I would like to explain to you how to get the following blueprints:

Witch hat, witch costume, skeleton mask, skeleton costume and the civil war clothes.

But before I get to the clothes blueprints, I would like to briefly explain to you what a random encounter is, because this is exactly where you can find these blueprints.

## RANDOM ENCOUNTER

Random Encounters are fixed locations (spawn points) in the game where random encounters appear. And there are a lot of them - both from the spawn points (a few hundred) and from the random encounters (there are currently over 150 listed).

These are distributed across all regions and divided into different groups. One of these groups, for example, is the Assault encounters, in which 2 factions fight each other.

**Little tip:** Here you can specifically increase your reputation, because if one of these factions are settlers or raiders, you will receive a little reputation as a thank you if you successfully support them.

A crashed vertibird, a fearful settler fleeing from a chicken, the robot selling lemonade, a crashed satellite, a talking raider power suit, a horde of bears attacking a mega sloth mother with her children or the fights between two factions mentioned above - to name just a few of these many encounters. There are also many corpses to be found here that have one or two treasures with them.

It is pure chance what you find in the respective places. There is also no trick to trigger the same encounter again and again. Additionally, you need to know that these encounters are time-limited. This means that after a certain time they disappear and are replaced by another one. Unfortunately, I can't tell you exactly how much time has to pass until the old one is replaced by a new one. My tests have shown that this takes approximately 30 to 60 minutes.

You will find a link below that leads to the Fallout Wiki. Here you can find an overview of all random encounters and also a map of the different spawn points.

BUT – unfortunately the list is only 95% correct – but still very helpful!

## RARE BUILDING PLANS MADE OF CORPSES

Now we come to the rare clothing blueprints. Rare because, as you read above, there are a lot of random encounters and it's not that easy to find the right one.

You can find all blueprints on 3 different corpses in three different regions. This is the dead candy collector, the dead Civil War actor and a dead raider. Below I will list which blueprints you can get in which region. Attached you will also find pictures of all the costumes and corpses!

Important: Unfortunately there is no 100% chance - sometimes the corpses don't have a blueprint with them.

## **Dead Candy Collector – REGION: Savage Divine**

• Halloween witch hat

• Halloween witch costume

• Halloween skull mask

• Halloween skeleton costume

**INFO:** The vampire costume does not exist! This was only available in the Atomic Shop.

## **Dead Civil War Reenactor - REGION: Toxic Valley**

• Civil War dress

• Civil War Cylinder

• Civil War suit

• Confederate hat

• Confederate uniform

• Northern hat

• Northern uniform

## **Dead Raider – REGION: Moor**

• Ski outfit (purple-white)

A picture of the corpse will be added later!

If you have any questions or suggestions, just write them in the comments!

Finally, a big THANK YOU to Marc Lili for the great photo shoot and to Jan Stavginski for supporting us in researching all the chance encounters!

Kind regards and good luck - Magga
